mainEntity.name: What is the difference between clear-span and multi-span metal framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear-span design provides complete, column-free interior floor space, but multi-span framing reduces material costs on large buildings. Clear-span frames use heavier, deeper structural rafters and columns to bridge the entire distance without center posts, which maximizes usable interior room for equipment or inventory. Multi-span frames introduce interior support columns, which reduces the required steel weight and foundation sizing. If your floor plan accommodates interior posts, multi-span construction provides significant structural cost savings for wide commercial footprints.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear-span offers completely column-free interior space using heavier steel members, whereas multi-span uses interior support columns to reduce framing weight and overall cost.
